text:
milan: Heads-up — main pipeline went red immediately after the merge from @ryan. Failing job: integration/scheduler-kv (kv_persistence_test). Anyone oncall who can grab this?
ci-bot: [CI] build 873212 failed on integration/scheduler-kv. Log: https://ci.internal/873212 — tests: kv_persistence_test (timeout)
devon: I can take a quick look, re-running the job now to rule out transient infra flake.
tara: pinging owners: @ryan were you the PR author? any config touches to KV layer?
ryan: I merged a small proto change + a serialization tweak earlier but nothing that should affect persistence. 2-file change: proto/schema.proto + opts/ser.go
milan: observed failure shows timeout in test waiting for write ack, stack shows scheduler not receiving commit callback. small sample from the log:```
2026-03-17T12:34:56Z ERROR scheduler: commit callback not invoked for shard=42
2026-03-17T12:34:57Z WARN kv: write latency > 10s, retrying
```
devon: rerun queued: https://ci.internal/retry/873212 (started)
ci-bot: [CI] rebuild 873212-rerun started on runner-gpu-7
ryan: hmm, serialization tweak touched message header ordering. I'll grep for places that assume ordering.
devon: rerun still failing, same test timing out. Not a transient infra issue.
sre-oncall: assigning pager since it's blocking main. If we need rollback candidate, what commit range?
devon: suspect range: before merge was 2104980000 (green) -> after merge 2105009000 (red). I can bisect but need guidance if we prefer revert first.
tara: if bisect takes >30m, prefer temporary revert of the PR that touched ser.go (ryan's PR). Could you get a quick revert PR, @ryan?
ryan: will open revert now. If devon bisects, share the commit that introduced regression and we'll ship revert+fix.
devon: starting git bisect locally:```
git bisect start 2105009000 2104980000
# running test subset: integration/scheduler-kv::kv_persistence_test
```
devon: first bisect step points at commit 2104998801 (author: ryan) — file opts/ser.go changed ordering. Skipping other unrelated merges.
ryan: confirmed I touched that exact file. I'm rolling up a quick patch to restore previous header order and will push test-only change.
milan: thanks. whoever fixes, please add a tiny regression test for header ordering with persistence flow.
ci-bot: [CI] rebuild 873260 (after ryan's patch) queued
devon: will keep monitoring. If anyone sees main still red after this, escalate to infra-sre. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: [CI] build 873260 passed — integration/scheduler-kv ok. main is passing again.
milan: great — thanks everyone. leaving notes: revert not required; fix landed by author. please add short postmortem in #postmortems with root cause and follow-up (serialization assumptions).
